title: ChatGPT Reached 900 Million Active Users
closing: Massive free adoption makes the service influential, expensive, and dependent on whoever pays the bill.
question: Do you use ChatGPT weekly?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users. A chatbot became a global habit at unprecedented scale.
ChatGPT reached its first major audience in 2 months. Earlier social apps needed far longer.
ChatGPT has 850 million free users. Most of its audience creates costs without directly paying.
